CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of General Epistle: James? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of General Epistle: James with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say General Epistle: James has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Epistle: James.
   D. Use General Epistle: James to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings.
   C. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o? (1 mark)
   A. Use : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing : 1Peter Selected teachings ● Christian Suffering/ Persecution ● Good Stewards o.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection.
   C. Say Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Jesus Passion, Death and Resurrection to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

7. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem.
   B. Apply the teaching of Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Jesus Ministry in Jerusalem has no place in daily life.

9. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

10. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Study Methods Devotional Method.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Prophet Hosea? (1 mark)

   B. Say Prophet Hosea has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Prophet Hosea to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Schism and Syncretism in Israel? (1 mark)

   B. Say Schism and Syncretism in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Schism and Syncretism in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Schism and Syncretism in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Monarchy in Israel: King David? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Restoration of Judah: Nehemiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
